utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. Mr. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning everyone in and around the courtroom. This is case number IT-04-81-T, The Prosecutor versus Momcilo Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Can we have the appearances for today, starting with the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. THOMAS
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. Barney Thomas and Carmela Javier for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Thomas. And for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning to the Prosecution and other people in the courtroom. This mourning there is Daniela Tasic, Chad Mair, Novak Lukic, and I'm Gregor Guy-Smith representing Momcilo Perisic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. Mr. Thomas.

utterances.speaker: MR. THOMAS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. If we could please move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: May the Chamber please move into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we're back in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you so much. The Chamber is adjourned to tomorrow morning, 9.00, Courtroom II. Court adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 29th day of April, 2009, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.57 a.m.,
